title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
title_zh: 解密 Autoresearch 框架：上下文与技能如何塑造自演化智能体
abstract_en: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\mathrm{fast}_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substantially outperforming AIDE and OpenEvolve under the same inference budget. Overall, our study distills design principles for preserving experimental history and curating reusable lessons in autoresearch harnesses, paving the way for agents that turn accumulated experience into sustained progress.
abstract_zh: Autoresearch 智能体能够自主设计、运行并迭代实验，尤其有望加速 AI 研究。但现有运行框架（harness）往往将多种机制捆绑在一起，难以判断各组件对性能的独立贡献。本文从两个维度研究长程自演化智能体的框架设计：上下文管理决定保留哪些历史尝试，技能管理决定如何存储和复用从尝试中获得的经验。研究在统一的智能体框架中，使用 gpt-oss-120b、gpt-6-luna 和 gpt-6-sol 在 MLE-Bench 与 KernelBench 上开展评估，并将各项设计与仅保留近期上下文的截断基线比较。结果表明，保留可单独查阅的历史尝试记录比维护滚动摘要更有效；上下文折叠（context folding）在六种设置中均表现最佳，相对基线最高提升 19.2%。在技能管理方面，有选择地删除长期未被使用的经验，平均比合并经验或将其提升为常设规则更有效。基于这些发现，作者将上下文折叠与技能删除（skill deletion）结合为 MLEvolver，在 MLE-Bench Lite 上取得 72.7% 的获奖率，在 KernelBench Level 3 上取得 94% 的 fast₁ 得分，并在相同推理预算下显著优于 AIDE 和 OpenEvolve。
key_points_zh: 在统一框架下，以近期截断为基线，通过三个模型和两个基准组成的六种设置，分别衡量上下文与技能管理策略的贡献。
可单独查阅的实验记录优于滚动摘要；上下文折叠在六种设置中均表现最佳，相对基线最高提升 19.2%。
对于可复用经验，选择性删除长期未用的条目，平均比合并条目或将其设为常设规则更有效。
MLEvolver 结合上下文折叠与技能删除，在 MLE-Bench Lite 达到 72.7% 的获奖率，在 KernelBench Level 3 达到 94% 的 fast₁ 得分，同等推理预算下优于 AIDE 和 OpenEvolve。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是在同一软件代理框架内逐项替换五种记忆机制，检验代理如何利用执行反馈更新任务内技能库并改进后续尝试。三种骨干、两项基准及无技能消融支持两项设计选择：在固定上下文预算下保留可按需展开的逐次记录，并剪除持续未被选用的技能。论文量化了上下文开销和后期改进率，但未证明改进机制本身会递归升级。
